info.title: Travbook discovery API
info.description: Travbook integrates verified OIDC customer identity and persistent self-service profiles with explicitly MOCK travel discovery and fulfilment. Profile data is stored in PostgreSQL, independent of travel mode; contact changes remain unverified and do not change the login identity or authorize messages. Flights, hotels, rail, buses, holidays and cabs provide the implemented scoped discovery/quotation/booking/aftercare operations below using deterministic providers. No real funds, external inventory, valid PNR/ticket/voucher or live GPS integration is enabled. SANDBOX/LIVE configurations fail closed until approved adapters exist. Cookie mutations require CSRF; bearer tokens require verified signature/issuer/audience/expiry plus the scopes documented per operation. Ownership, authoritative prices, immutable quote acceptance, idempotency and separate booking/reservation/payment/refund states are enforced server-side. Asynchronous acceptance is not confirmation. Monetary amounts are decimal strings with ISO currency; timestamps preserve UTC events and journey zones. Responses are no-store with correlation IDs and application/problem+json failures. Versioned APIs preserve prior accepted terms and supported capabilities; use each operation description for constraints, mode, validation, replay and error behavior. Lifecycle outboxes are durable, but not every event stream has downstream delivery. Authorized payment webhooks/settlement, notification delivery, externally valid documents, production IdP provisioning and AWS deployment remain incomplete. Optional authenticated /api/v1/demo APIs provide local dummy messaging/privacy jobs, coupon previews, synthetic cab positions and owner-scoped MOCK ledger reports. These do not enable production integrations or AWS. The optional /api/v1/demo/flight-provider contract is an independent fictional airline/payment test double with owned persistent quotes, exclusive seats, payment outcomes, ticketing, check-in and full cancellation/refund. It does not fulfil existing platform bookings or issue valid travel documents.

Same customer/key/body returns the original acknowledgement, including after expiry. Changed payload conflicts. Different keys for an identical quote/body recover the same intent; different travellers for an already consumed quote conflict. Names are trimmed, whitespace collapsed and Unicode NFC normalized; traveller order is significant.

get.summary: Read owned booking, validation workflow and separate reservation/payment states
get.description: Requires bookings:read. Pending validation is polled with bounded backoff; AWAITING_PAYMENT means validation succeeded, not a hold, reservation, charge or confirmation. Other owners receive 404. Once a v2 checkout starts, this legacy validation-only resource returns 409 BOOKING_CONFLICT directing the client to /api/v2/bookings/{id}; it never returns false NOT_STARTED payment metadata. Existing v1 list status describes validation only.

get.summary: Read the owned, durably delivered booking-intent timeline
get.description: Requires bookings:read and ownership; other owners receive 404. Read-only, no idempotency key. Returns immutable MOCK lifecycle history ordered by aggregate version ascending, excluding traveller data and internal correlation IDs. afterVersion is an exclusive version cursor (default 0), size defaults to 20, maximum 50. Cursor cannot exceed the delivered prefix; invalid cursors return 422. nextAfterVersion is null when the page reaches the delivered prefix. bookingVersion and deliveredVersion describe a consistent local snapshot; PENDING means delivery lags, ATTENTION_REQUIRED means a quarantined event blocks this booking. Eventually consistent history is never proof of reservation or payment. No cache; bounded UI polling stops on catch-up/attention or its budget. Times are ISO-8601 instants. The existing booking status API remains authoritative.

get.summary: Read validation and independent checkout states
get.description: Requires bookings:read and owned intent; 404 for other owners. No-store. checkout null means no payment/reservation workflow has started. Validation status remains separate. Only checkout CONFIRMED with CAPTURED payment and CONFIRMED supplier means simulated fulfilment, never a real ticket. Bounded polling (max 20, exponential to 8s) until terminal or review. ISO timestamps; decimal-string INR totals. If a cancellation case exists (or any returned list item has one), this legacy read fails closed with 409 BOOKING_CONFLICT directing callers to v3. Old responses never silently hide cancellation.

post.summary: Durably accept a MOCK authorize/reserve/capture workflow
post.description: Requires bookings:write, ownership, cookie CSRF, exact accepted unexpired quote and completed offer validation. Rechecks price/availability before effects. Body has explicit simulation scenario and consent; no client price or owner. Idempotency-Key scoped to customer/start-checkout, same body replays stable 202; changed body 409. One checkout per intent even with different keys. No card/UPI data collected, no real funds. Unknown effects reconcile by stable operation ID; bounded attempts then REVIEW.

get.summary: List owned MOCK confirmation summaries
get.description: bookings:read plus resource ownership; 404 for another customer. Requires confirmed MOCK checkout with CAPTURED payment and CONFIRMED supplier, otherwise 409 BOOKING_CONFLICT. No creation on read. Fixed kind/version; at most one document, no pagination. Empty items means eligible but not generated. No-store; timestamps are ISO instants. This is not a ticket or tax invoice. Active, cancelled or unresolved cancellation blocks generation and download with 409; historical saved files cannot be recalled.

post.summary: Generate an immutable owned MOCK confirmation summary
post.description: bookings:write, ownership, cookie CSRF and Idempotency-Key required. Server derives all content from confirmed checkout and accepted journey; no client names, references or prices accepted. Same customer/key/body replays the original document; changed booking with the same key conflicts. Different keys for one booking recover its one immutable document. 409 if unconfirmed, failed, pending or REVIEW. No real ticket/invoice. Content and a privacy-safe creation event commit atomically; event publication pending. No-store. Active, cancelled or unresolved cancellation blocks generation and download with 409; historical saved files cannot be recalled.

get.summary: Download an owned MOCK summary as an attachment
get.description: bookings:read, booking/document ownership and confirmed-checkout eligibility rechecked on every read. Indistinguishable 404 for missing/foreign document. Persisted bytes are integrity-checked; no token in the URL. Response is UTF-8 text, attachment, no-store, nosniff; not a real ticket, voucher or tax invoice. No range or conditional-cache semantics are supported. Active, cancelled or unresolved cancellation blocks generation and download with 409; historical saved files cannot be recalled.

post.summary: Quote a full-booking MOCK cancellation
post.description: Requires bookings:write, ownership, session CSRF and idempotency key. Confirmed captured MOCK booking, supported accepted policy, confirmed provider reservation and future first departure required. Legacy/unknown policies fail closed with 409 BOOKING_CONFLICT; never infer tax refunds. Server-owned BigDecimal INR totals. Quote version 1 expires after five minutes or departure, whichever is earlier. Exact-key replay returns historical quote including expiry. No cancellation effect. No-store.

post.summary: Accept an owned cancellation quote and begin recovery-safe cancellation/refund
post.description: Requires bookings:write, ownership, CSRF, Idempotency-Key and explicit exact-quote consent. Server validates ownership, version and expiry. One case per booking; equivalent retry recovers its stable ACK even after expiry; changed quote/scenario conflicts. Supplier cancellation and refund are independent. Unknown outcomes reconcile before retry; exhausted work enters REVIEW. Full-booking only, no partial passenger cancellation. No real funds. No-store.

Bounded UI polling max 20 reads/backoff to 8 seconds; terminal/review stops polling.

post.description: Public MOCK hotel discovery only. No reservation, hold, charge or owned quotation is created. All totals are authoritative decimal-string INR amounts including simulated taxes/fees. Stay dates are local to the property (Asia/Kolkata). No-store responses include X-Correlation-ID.
